subject: Close Chronicle: please claim orphaned opps and update close/stage
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance@heliohealth.com
Date: Fri, 17 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Close Chronicle: please claim orphaned opps and update close/stage

Team —

Quick hygiene nudge before we lock the May commitment snapshot next Tuesday. Finance surfaced a handful of deals tied to HelioHealth (deal HL-4372 and related line items) that show no activity for 60+ days and have inconsistent stage/close-date entries in SF. If these are still live, we need up-to-date close dates + evidence; if not, mark them as Lost/Withdrawn so forecast math stays honest.

Please:
- Claim HL-4372 or transfer ownership by EOD Monday (2029-05-20).
- Update Stage to the accurate sentinel (Proposal / Contract / Closed-Won / Closed-Lost).
- Attach minimal evidence in the linked spreadsheet (one row per opp): customer contact, next step, required evidence.

I've attached a short extract (close_evidence.xlsx) and a PDF ranking of deals I pulled (deal_ranking.pdf). If you think the close date should move, put a short justification in the "notes" column in the sheet — finance will reconcile.

If this is something you need me to unblock (credit, executive intro, extra trial), reply with the exact ask and I will escalate.

Thanks — quick actions here materially affect our monthly recognition.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Manager, Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: close_evidence.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), deal_ranking.pdf (PDF stub)

Thanks Marissa — on it.

I'm claiming HL-4372; had a quiet week with HelioHealth but we do have a contract review scheduled next Wednesday (2029-05-22). I'll update SF with the expected close date of 2029-05-29 and drop the review summary + POV into the "notes" column in the sheet.

If we need finance to hold recognition until signed, flag that after I update.

—Ben

Adding a quick operational note: I exported the affected opps and standardised the date fields — exported subset attached to the Drive link. A couple of data hygiene wrinkles I flagged in column D: mismatched timezone stamps and duplicate opportunity records that were merged incorrectly.

My pro-tip for claims: if you expect client signatures but no payment yet, set Stage to "Contract" and put the tentative close date + one-line rationale. Finance prefers an explicit note over leaving date blank.

I'll mark the ones I suspect are duplicates as "review" in SF so we don't delete anything accidentally. Ben — when you update, set the "evidence_type" to one of: PO received / Signed contract / Exec confirmation. That will make the recognition path clearer.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Sales Strategy Lead
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Ben and Rishi. Two quick items as we finalize the snapshot:

1) Ben — please confirm in SF by EOD Friday (2029-05-24) that HL-4372 has the updated close date and attach the contract-review notes. If Helio moves the date out of quarter, we will need a short memo to finance requesting recognition deferral.

2) Monica — I left three opps in the sheet unassigned that appear genuinely orphaned. If no one claims by Monday (2029-05-27), I'll run the archive workflow and move them to Stale -> Closed-Lost.

3) Finance — thanks for flagging this. If you need any additional evidence fields for the recognition gate, let me know and I'll add them to the template.

If I don't hear back on the two bullets above, I'll escalate to the manager level on Tuesday to preserve the integrity of the forecast.

Thanks —
Marissa
